options.denominator: None; absolute number of crash records
options.reason: Absolute counts directly answer how many recorded crashes fell on each weekday over the full period.
options.answer: Friday had the most recorded crashes (338,800), while Sunday had the fewest (257,544) among 2,132,218 crashes dated 2013–2025.

options.reason: Percentages make each weekday's contribution to the full-period total easy to compare as a composition.
options.answer: Friday accounted for 15.89% of all recorded crashes, the largest weekday share, while Sunday accounted for 12.08%, the smallest.

options.metric: Share of that year's crash records (percent)
options.denominator: All crash records in the same calendar year
options.reason: Year-specific shares show whether the weekday mix was consistent or changed across the study period.
options.answer: Friday had the largest share of crashes in 13 of the 13 years, and Sunday had the smallest share in 13 years; the lines show the annual weekday mix rather than cumulative volume.

answer:
By total crash count, Friday had the most recorded crashes (338,800) and Sunday the fewest (257,544) from 2013 through 2025.  
By share of all crashes in that period, Friday accounted for the largest share (15.89%) and Sunday the smallest (12.08%).  
By annual share, Friday had the largest weekday share in all 13 years, while Sunday had the smallest in all 13 years.
